The '''Tularan Marsh''' was a swamp on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that formed at the site of several abandoned [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] tracks. By [[3643 BBY]], the region had become a swamp, and the area was home to [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]], [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], [[ferrazid hound]]s, and [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwings]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] restoration effort set up two research stations near the marsh, and pirates had a camp south of it.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a traveling hero ventured into the eastern end of the marsh to help [[Tarkos Sund]] recover the [[prototype accelerator]] used by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to beat [[Brejik]] in a swoop race.

Following the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Taris]], the Tularan Marsh became one of the last areas on the planet where Republic defenders, led by Major [[Kamden]], offered organized, although ultimately futile, [[Tularan Marsh offensive|resistance]] to the invaders.<ref name="TOR Bonus">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Taris: Bonus Series (Empire)|Taris}}</ref>
